meta.name: cellxgene-census
meta.description: Query the CZ CELLxGENE Census programmatically for versioned public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data. Use when you need population-scale cell metadata, gene expression slices, Census summary counts, source H5AD URIs/downloads, embeddings, spatial Census data, or reference atlas comparisons across organisms, tissues, diseases, assays, and cell types. For analyzing your own local single-cell data use scanpy, anndata, or scvi-tools.

copy.tagline: 查询公共单细胞和空间转录组数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要从CZ CELLxGene数据库获取版本化的单细胞和转录组数据
copy.tagline_en: Query public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need versioned single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data from CZ CELLxGene

howto.what: 装上该技能后，Claude 能够通过 Python 代码查询 CZ CELLxGENE Census 数据库，获取公开的单细胞与空间转录组数据，包括细胞元数据、基因表达矩阵、数据集统计信息等，并返回分析结果。
howto.when: 当您需要查询单细胞或空间转录组数据（如细胞类型、组织、疾病等特定条件下的基因表达或数据集信息）时触发。

say.text: 帮我查人类肺中T细胞在COVID-19下的基因表达。
say.note: Claude会查询Census数据并返回结果。

say.text: 列出2025-11-08版本Census中所有小鼠脑细胞类型。
say.note: Claude会获取并列出细胞类型列表。

say.text: 对比人类与小鼠肝脏中巨噬细胞的基因表达谱。
say.note: Claude会跨物种查询并给出比较结果。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can query the CZ CELLxGENE Census via Python code to retrieve public single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data, including cell metadata, gene expression matrices, dataset summaries, and more, then present the results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to query single-cell or spatial transcriptomics data, such as gene expression or dataset info filtered by cell type, tissue, disease, etc.

say_en.text: Query gene expression of T cells in human lung with COVID-19.
say_en.note: Claude will query Census data and return results.

say_en.text: List all mouse brain cell types in the 2025-11-08 Census release.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve and list the cell types.

say_en.text: Compare macrophage gene expression between human and mouse liver.
say_en.note: Claude will perform a cross-species query and compare.
